keyVerseDR: "That they all may be one, as thou, Father, in me, and I in thee..." (Jn 17:21)

level1.title: Jesus Prays for Us
level1.story: Jesus prayed for His friends and for us. He asked God that we would all be one. Jesus wants us to love each other like one family.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you help your family get along?
level1.prayer: Jesus, help us all be one. Amen.

activity.title: Pray as one
activity.intro: Jesus prayed that we all be one.

level2.title: That They May All Be One
level2.story: Jesus lifted up His eyes and prayed, "Not for them only do I pray, but for them also who through their word shall believe in Me." He prayed that they all may be one, as the Father is in Him and He in the Father. Jesus said He gave them the glory the Father gave Him. He prayed that the world may know that the Father sent Him and loves them. Jesus said, "Father, I will that where I am, they also whom Thou hast given Me may be with Me."
level2.keyLine: That they all may be one.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why does unity help others believe?
How can you build unity at home or school?
level2.prayer: Jesus, make us one in Your love. Amen.

activity.title: That all may be one
activity.intro: Write a family prayer for unity.
